page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 physical cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor is relatively weak, falling in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests. Single-threaded gzip compression is also poor, placing in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores all positioning in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests, including both cached small-block and uncached large-block reads, consistently achieve average tier results.

The ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge offers a balanced resource profile with dedicated CPU allocation, making it a stable option for workloads that can leverage multi-threaded execution to overcome modest single-core speeds. The lack of local storage and GPU hardware limits its utility for high-speed local data caching or accelerated machine learning tasks. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for legacy enterprise applications, multi-threaded database operations, static web serving, and general-purpose workloads that require a steady 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio without demanding the highest single-thread performance.
